title: Guidelines for stability for inland and harbour vessels, Part 1 Decked vessels
clause_1_scope: 1. Scope — This standard lays down the guidelines pertaining to stability of decked inland and harbour vessels, which fall under the purview of Inland Vessels Act 1977 and Coasting Vessels Act 1838 ( as amended in 1952 ).
clause_3_terminology: Guidelines for stability for inland and harbour vessels

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
